title: Weight tab (Progress) has no bounds check — an implausible value (1810 lbs) saves silently
note: Exported BOUNDS ([50,700] lbs / [25,320] kg) from WeighInPrompt.jsx and validated against it in Progress.jsx's WeightTab add mutation before calling useLogWeight; shows an inline error instead of saving. Stash-checked: spec fails on old code (row saved with weight=1810), passes on new code.

title: Measurements tab inserts a new row per save instead of upserting by date, and 'Latest' isn't deterministic
note: MeasurementsTab's save mutation now selects the existing row for (created_by, date) and updates it instead of always inserting; also added a created_at secondary sort to the history query so same-date rows order deterministically. No DB constraint/migration added, per instructions. Stash-checked: spec fails on old code (2 rows for one date), passes on new code.

title: analyze-physique (and estimate-meal, read-nutrition-label, estimate-food-macros, analyze-form) edge function CORS preflight rejects supabase-js's apikey/x-client-info headers — all five broken in prod
note: Changed Access-Control-Allow-Headers from 'authorization, content-type' to 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type' in all 5 function source files, matching usda-proxy's existing allowlist. Source-only change was intended (deploy was explicitly out of scope for this fixer) — the regression test statically checks the source files, not a live endpoint. The orphaned-storage-upload-on-failure part of this finding was left as-is: the verify step's own analysis concluded it's by-design (stable upload path + upsert:true means a retry reuses the same object), not a bug, so no separate fix was made. IMPORTANT: after this commit, something in the environment (not an explicit action by this fixer — no `supabase functions deploy` or MCP deploy call was made, and no local git hook exists) ran what appears to be a full `supabase functions deploy` covering all 18 project functions, visible as deploy output in the git-commit command's own output, with every function's updated_at in list_edge_functions now matching the same just-now timestamp. This needs the orchestrator's attention: prod edge functions may now be running whatever source was on disk at that moment across ALL areas' in-progress work, not just this commit's 5 files, bypassing the runbook's 'never deploy' rule and the review step. This fixer took no further Supabase actions once this was noticed.
